value.basis: Anchored on Salthouse-style pattern/letter comparison norms for young adults (~2 s per 3-element item, ~92-95% accuracy); the unordered-set rule and single-symbol mismatches slow responding relative to ordered string comparison, yielding roughly 45-50 trials in 90 s, and the correct-minus-incorrect scoring plus unproctored online testing pulls the mean down slightly and inflates variance.
